body:
Found by the T129 golden master (PR #1102, issue #670), which replays the original's recorded battles through the port.  Example: mix-rg_s1, BATTLE06, Gaul slots 22/23: first differing draw is draw 24, half-round 6, site 0x439557, original Random(1085), port Random(172). Likely targeting, claims or order. After emulating findings 1 to 3 in a scratch harness, 276 of 318 hooked series replay exactly; these are among the rest.

## Triage decision (2026-10-14)

**Lane: investigation, then an evidence-backed correction task. Blocked on cause attribution and the prerequisite tactical corrections.** Jev proposes task (0.95), confirmed: a resolver/AI targeting change cannot use the fix lane.

The old combined-emulation survey reports 42 unexplained hooked series. The committed T129 registry currently links 57 case entries across 41 distinct series to this issue; these are different units of counting, and attribution is provisional. Do not claim the missing survey series was fixed without a reconciled trial/case inventory.

Next: after copy-in, general-control and exhausted-move ordering are independently corrected, rerun the 318 hook logs against the immutable original draws. Reconcile the trial ids with the old 42-series survey. For each surviving divergence record first draw index, half-round, site, original range/result, port range/result, actor/target and production general pass. Start with mix-rg_s1 BATTLE06 Gaul slots 22/23. Check target claims, iteration/pass order and flank eligibility against the pinned original listing before selecting a fix.

Only then write a bounded correction contract with exact production paths and named reproduction cases. No unexplained range rebaselining, combined emulation committed into the harness, permissive expected-failure catch, or original-file changes. T129 must merge before its registry is edited. Retain Wine-candidate/hypothesis provenance throughout.
